Author: Sansflaire
Name: LimLo Toolkit
Punchline: A standalone box of small quality-of-life tools.
Description: LimLoToolkit is a single window that collects small quality-of-life tools. Coffer Lines draws a line from you to nearby bronze and silver treasure coffers while you are in the Occult Crescent. Alongside it sit a live character and zone readout and an Eorzea clock with the next weather window. Every tool can be switched on or off individually. The plugin is fully standalone — it needs no other plugins installed and talks to nothing outside the game.
